Part 1 - one dimensional PDP

```{r, echo = TRUE}
library(randomForest)
library(pdp)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

bike_data <- read.csv("Practica 5 Sin sol/day.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

bike_data <- bike_data %>%
  mutate(
    temp = temp * (39 - (-8)) + (-8),      
    hum = hum * 100,                        
    windspeed = windspeed * 67,         
    days_since_2011 = as.numeric(as.Date(dteday) - as.Date("2011-01-01"))
  )

features <- c("days_since_2011", "temp", "hum", "windspeed")
model_data <- bike_data[, c(features, "cnt")]

#training random forest model
set.seed(42) 
rf_bike_model <- randomForest(cnt ~ ., data = model_data, ntree = 500)

#PDP
plot_pdp <- function(feature_name, title_label, x_label) {
  pd_data <- partial(rf_bike_model, pred.var = feature_name, plot = FALSE)
  
  ggplot(pd_data, aes_string(x = feature_name, y = "yhat")) +
    geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Feature influence:", title_label),
         x = x_label,
         y = "Prediction")
}

pdp_days  <- plot_pdp("days_since_2011", "Time lapse", "Days since 01.01.2011")
pdp_temp  <- plot_pdp("temp", "Temperature", "Temperature")
pdp_hum   <- plot_pdp("hum", "Humidity", "Humidity")
pdp_wind  <- plot_pdp("windspeed", "Wind speed", "Wind speed")

print(pdp_days)
print(pdp_temp)
print(pdp_hum)
print(pdp_wind)

```

Part 2 - bidimensional PDP

```{r, echo = TRUE}
#generating data for 2D PDP
#we take a random sample n = 100
sampled_data <- model_data[sample(nrow(model_data), 100), ]

pdp_2d <- partial(rf_bike_model, 
                 pred.var = c("temp", "hum"), 
                 grid.resolution = 50,
                 train = sampled_data)

#Visualization using geom_tile()
plot_2d <- ggplot(pdp_2d, aes(x = temp, y = hum)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = yhat), width = 1.5, height = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(terrain.colors(10)), name = "Predicted cnt") +
  geom_rug(data = sampled_data, aes(x = temp, y = hum), sides = "bl", alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "temperature and humidity interaction",
       x = "Temperature",
       y = "Humidity")

print(plot_2d)

```

Part 3 - PDP to explain the price of a house

```{r, echo = TRUE}
library(randomForest)
library(pdp)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

house_data <- read.csv("Practica 5 Sin sol/kc_house_data.csv")

#features: bedrooms, bathrooms, sqft_living, sqft_lot, floors, yr_built
selected_features <- c("bedrooms", "bathrooms", "sqft_living", "sqft_lot", "floors", "yr_built")
model_data <- house_data[, c(selected_features, "price")]

#we have 1000 - 2000 samples
set.seed(42)
sampled_data <- model_data[sample(nrow(model_data), 2000), ]

#training random forest
#A model that predicts the price based on selected features
rf_house_model <- randomForest(price ~ ., data = sampled_data, ntree = 500)

#1D partial dependence plot
plot_house_pdp <- function(feature_name, title_label, x_label) {
  pd_data <- partial(rf_house_model, pred.var = feature_name, plot = FALSE)
  
  ggplot(pd_data, aes_string(x = feature_name, y = "yhat")) +
    geom_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(color = "darkred", alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("House proce influence:", title_label),
         x = x_label,
         y = "Predicted price") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format())
}

pdp_bedrooms  <- plot_house_pdp("bedrooms", "Bedrooms", "Bedrooms")
pdp_bathrooms <- plot_house_pdp("bathrooms", "Number of bathrooms", "Bathrooms")
pdp_living    <- plot_house_pdp("sqft_living", "Living space", "Square footage")
pdp_floors    <- plot_house_pdp("floors", "Number of floors", "Floors")

print(pdp_bedrooms)
print(pdp_bathrooms)
print(pdp_living)
print(pdp_floors)

```
